temporal_notes: Collections were conducted in April and November 2009.
coord_source_text: Tororo District (0°45' N, 34°5' E) in Eastern Uganda
source_text: Blood fed An. funestus adult females resting indoor were collected in houses between 06 and 12 AM in Tororo District... carried out in April and November 2009... A PCR was carried out using the protocol of [10] to confirm that all females that laid eggs were An. funestus s.s.
